scheme: Square level tiles in a CSS-style grid, used the same way for Act 1, Act 2 and Act 3. Origin of the grid is the top-left of layout.json map_inner. Tiles flow left-to-right, top-to-bottom in story order. There are no per-tile UVs. The Meadow overview (Hub map button) is not a grid — see overview.

columns.landscape_short_when: orientation is landscape AND the viewport is 500 CSS px tall or less. The 844×390 phone artboard uses landscape_short.

tile.note: Author at 112×112 (and @2x). The rounded face is inset 8 CSS px so the selected ring stays on-canvas. Scale down uniformly to the orientation size. Do not shrink below 48 px. Short-landscape pad is 8 so five 96 px tiles with 8 px column gaps fit the 528 px well exactly. Overlays (number, badge, Starseed) sit inside the face with at least 4 CSS px clear of any edge, at every tile size including 96 px. Stars are not on the face — see star_row.

slots_on_source_112.note: Number, badge and Starseed stay inside the face. Values already include a 6 px inset on the 112 source (5.1 px once scaled to a 96 px tile), which meets the 4 px display minimum. Stars are not a face slot.

scroll.rule: Lay out tiles in `columns` columns with column `gap` and `pad`. Each cell is tile height + star_row (4 px gap_above + 24 px art). Row gap (8) sits between the star row of one cell and the next tile. If the block is taller than map_inner.height, the grid scrolls vertically inside the well (no scroll-x, no shrinking tiles below 48 px). Portrait: 3 cells of 130 + 2×8 gaps + 2×10 pad = 426, well 496, leftover 70 — 3×3 of 9 tiles fits, no scroll. Short landscape: 2 cells of 124 + 8 gap + 2×8 pad = 272, well 282, leftover 10 — 5+4 of 9 tiles fits, no scroll. A taller landscape using 4 columns needs 3 rows for 9 tiles and will scroll on a 282 px-tall well.

new.note: Unplayed. Cream rounded square, empty well.

played.stars: stars-0 in the star row under scored levels; hide the row on tutorials (the cell height is still reserved)
played.note: Visited, 0 stars (or a finished tutorial). Mint wash and a check.

stars_1_3.stars: nodes/stars-{1,2,3}.png in the star row under the tile
stars_1_3.note: Cleared with 1–3 base stars. Stars sit under the tile, 4 px clear of its bottom edge.

challenge_star.note: Dusk challenge badge, top-right inside the face, at least 4 CSS px from any edge. Stacks on any cleared state.

starseed.note: Secret Starseed found. 48×48 source, scaled into the starseed slot at the face's bottom-left, at least 4 CSS px from any edge. The tile itself is the tap target.

selected.note: The tile whose details are in the selected-level panel. Honey ring. Use this when the tile is selected but is not also current.

current.note: The player's current / last-played level. Honey fill + honey ring. If the current tile is also selected, use tile-current (do not stack both rings).

locked.note: Optional. Gates are off in the current beta (LEVEL_GATES_ENABLED = false).

tutorial.note: Training Garden and Trailhead Trials: no level number, no star row, trail badge in the badge slot.

overview.title: Meadow
overview.opens_from: The Hub's Levels / Trail Board button (#bHubMap). Tapping a region node opens that act's tab (the square-tile grid). Back in the header returns to the 3D Hub.
overview.source: Official design for the Hub map button. Three act-region nodes plus a Hub home pin, in the same shared frame. This is not a level grid.
overview.coordinate_scheme: Normalised 0–1 centres in layout.json map_inner (same well the grids use). Origin top-left. 56 CSS px nodes, tap 56.

star_row.note: Stars sit in a dedicated row under the tile, never on the rounded square and never touching a tile edge. gap_above_css (4) is clear space from the tile's bottom edge to the star art. The star asset itself has 4 CSS px of internal padding so the tips do not touch its own box. Cell height = tile height + gap_above + star asset height (102+4+24=130 portrait, 96+4+24=124 short landscape). The 8 px row gap then separates the star row from the next tile (also >= 4 px). Every cell reserves this row so the grid stays aligned when a tile has no stars (new levels, tutorials).

thumbs.note: Square thumbs fill the tile face inside the 2 CSS px stroke at the largest tile size (112). Scale down uniformly for 102 and 96 px tiles. 16:9 panel thumbs cover the selected-level card-thumb rects (portrait 148×84, landscape 236×110) without upscaling. Each entry in thumbs/thumbs.json maps a tile id to its intro card, the square crop, the 16:9 panel crop, and the shipped PNG/WebP files. Meadow Hub has no dedicated card; its thumb is a Home Stump crop of the Act 1 title.
